title: BoardGameGeek Play Log Weekly Play Time Trend
dataSources: BoardGameGeek plays (`bgg:play`), Poker Now sessions (`pokernow:session`), Bridge Base Online boards (`bridgebase:board`), and Lichess tournament rounds (`lichess:tournament`).
app: BoardGameGeek play logs, Poker Now session exports, Bridge Base Online boards, and Lichess tournament data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bgg:play play_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(play_minutes) as avg_duration, max(play_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst play time for BoardGameGeek play log events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture play_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average play time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether BoardGameGeek play log tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
